check_events.outcome: Conditional group-theoretic proof performed from the two displayed extensions: because pi is normal in E_{U_eta}, conjugation by a lift of e in E_eta gives an automorphism of pi. Replacing a lift x by a*x, with a in pi, changes the automorphism by an inner automorphism, so its class rho(e) in Out(pi) is well-defined; products of lifts show rho is a homomorphism. Write q:E_eta→E_k for the quotient in (30). If rho factors through q then every t in T has rho(t)=1. Conversely, if rho(T)=1, set bar-rho(q(e))=rho(e); two representatives differ by T and give the same value, so this is a well-defined unique homomorphism. Thus nontrivial rho|T prevents descent to E_k. Given a splitting s:E_k→E_eta, rho∘s is an outer action after that choice. This checks the abstract group-theoretic implication used in the prose, not the geometric assertion that rho|T is nontrivial; topological continuity is not separately proved. No omitted continuation after Mais tout scindage is supplied.
